| Label | Colour | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `v0.1` | `#0052CC` | In the v0.1 lite milestone |
| `v0.2` | `#5319E7` | Scheduled for v0.2 |
| `glue` | `#D93F0B` | Big Book code; counts against the 5–10k budget; read the ADR |
| `wire` | `#0E8A16` | Configure an upstream component + a test; no Big Book code |
| `packaging` | `#FBCA04` | compose, Helm, CI, install docs |
| `research` | `#C5DEF5` | Verify a claim about HAPI, Keycloak or Medplum; output is a doc change |

| `help wanted` | `#008672` | Open and unassigned |
| `blocked` | `#B60205` | Waiting on another issue or a verify-first answer |
| `question` | `#D876E3` | About a requirement or ADR |
| `adr` | `#BFD4F2` | Proposes or changes a decision in `docs/adr/` |

Applied: `good first issue` + `help wanted` on #11, #13, #14, #17. `blocked` on every issue whose "Blocked by" list has an open issue.
